[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Palola]] commanded a '''squad''' within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Ereesus Planetary Security Forces]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the course of the [[Battle of Ereesus|battle]] on [[Ereesus]].
